SELECT 
    transaction_date,
    DAYNAME(transaction_date) AS Day_name,
    MONTHNAME(transaction_date) AS Month_name,
     COUNT(transaction_id) AS number_of_sales,
     SUM(transaction_qty) AS units_sold,
     COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS unique_products,
     COUNT(store_id) AS number_of_stores,
     MAX(unit_price*transaction_qty) AS highest_price,
     AVG(unit_price*transaction_qty) AS average_price,
     MIN(unit_price*transaction_qty) AS lowest_price,
     AVG(unit_price*transaction_qty) AS average_revenue,
     SUM(transaction_qty * unit_price) AS revenue,

    CASE 
        WHEN DAYNAME(transaction_date) IN ('Sat','Sun') THEN 'Weekend'
        WHEN DAYNAME(transaction_date) IN ('Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri') THEN 'Weekday'
    END AS day_classification,

    CASE 
        WHEN transaction_time BETWEEN '06:00:00' AND '11:59:59' THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN transaction_time BETWEEN '12:00:00' AND '17:59:59' THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN transaction_time BETWEEN '18:00:00' AND '20:59:59' THEN 'Evening'
    END AS time_classification,  

    CASE
         WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31' THEN 'first_quarter_revenue'
         WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN 'second_quarter_revenue'
         END AS revenue_by_quarter,

         SUM(transaction_qty * unit_price) AS total_revenue,

    store_location,
    product_category,
    product_type,
    product_detail

FROM brightlearn.coffee_shop.bright_coffee_shop_sales_dataset

GROUP BY 
    transaction_date,
    month_name,
    store_location,
    product_category,
    product_type,
    product_detail,

    CASE 
        WHEN DAYNAME(transaction_date) IN ('Sat','Sun') THEN 'Weekend'
        WHEN DAYNAME(transaction_date) IN ('Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri') THEN 'Weekday'
    END,

    CASE 
        WHEN transaction_time BETWEEN '06:00:00' AND '11:59:59' THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN transaction_time BETWEEN '12:00:00' AND '17:59:59'  THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN transaction_time BETWEEN '18:00:00' AND '20:59:59' THEN 'Evening'
        END,

        CASE
         WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31' THEN 'first_quarter_revenue'
         WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN 'second_quarter_revenue'
    END;

lines: ☕ BRIGHT COFFEESALES ANALYSIS · JANUARY – JUNE 2023

## 📊 Overview

This dashboard analyzes **Bright Coffee Shop** sales across **January – June 2023**.

Explore revenue, units sold, and transaction patterns across:

* **3** store locations
* Multiple **product categories** & types
* Times of day, weekdays & weekends
* Months and quarters

Use the filters on the **Dashboard page** to slice the data any way you like.

## 🎯 Key Metrics

| Metric | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Revenue** | Monetary value of all sales |
| **Units Sold** | Total quantity of products sold |
| **Number of Sales** | Count of individual transactions |

These three headline metrics appear live across the **Dashboard** and **Detailed View** pages.

## 🧭 Page Guide

| Page | Content |
| --- | --- |
| **Dashboard** | Interactive analytics with filters |
| **Detailed View** | Pivot tables & granular breakdowns |
| **Glossary** | Metric & term definitions |

Start on the **Dashboard** page, then dive deeper in the **Detailed View**.
💡 Tip: Use the filters on the Dashboard page to explore by date range, store location, product category, and product type.

## Revenue Metrics

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Revenue** | The total monetary value of all sales, calculated as `SUM(transaction_qty × unit_price)`. |
| **Revenue** | Same calculation as Total Revenue — `SUM(transaction_qty × unit_price)`. |
| **Average Revenue** | The average revenue per transaction, calculated as `AVG(unit_price × transaction_qty)`. |
| **Average Price** | The average transaction value, calculated as `AVG(unit_price × transaction_qty)`. |
| **Highest Price** | The maximum single-transaction value, calculated as `MAX(unit_price × transaction_qty)`. |
| **Lowest Price** | The minimum single-transaction value, calculated as `MIN(unit_price × transaction_qty)`. |

## Sales & Transaction Metrics

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **Units Sold** | The total quantity of products sold, calculated as `SUM(transaction_qty)`. |
| **Number of Sales** | The total count of transactions, calculated as `COUNT(transaction_id)`. |
| **Unique Products** | The count of distinct product IDs sold, calculated as `COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)`. |
| **Number of Stores** | The total count of stores involved in transactions, calculated as `COUNT(store_id)`. |
| **Transaction Date** | The date on which a sales transaction occurred. |

## Time Classifications

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **Day Name** | The name of the day of the week extracted from the transaction date (e.g., Monday, Saturday). |
| **Month Name** | The name of the month extracted from the transaction date (e.g., January, June). |
| **Day Classification** | Categorises each day as **Weekday** (Mon–Fri) or **Weekend** (Sat–Sun). |
| **Time Classification** | Categorises transactions by time of day: **Morning** (06:00–11:59), **Afternoon** (12:00–17:59), or **Evening** (18:00–20:59). |
| **Revenue by Quarter** | Groups revenue into quarters: **First Quarter** (Jan–Mar 2023) and **Second Quarter** (Apr–Jun 2023). |

## Product & Store Dimensions

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **Store Location** | The physical location of the coffee shop where the transaction took place. |
| **Product Category** | The broad classification of products (e.g., Coffee, Tea, Bakery). |
| **Product Type** | The specific type within a product category (e.g., Gourmet Coffee, Herbal Tea). |
| **Product Detail** | The most granular description of the individual product sold. |

## Chart & Filter Terms

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **Daily Revenue Trend** | A line chart displaying total revenue aggregated by day, showing the revenue trend over time. |
| **Date Range Filter** | A filter allowing users to narrow the dashboard data to a specific date range. |
| **Store Location Filter** | A single-select dropdown filter to filter dashboard data by a specific store location. |
| **Product Category Filter** | A single-select dropdown filter to filter dashboard data by a specific product category. |
| **Product Type Filter** | A single-select dropdown filter to filter dashboard data by a specific product type. |
